Package com.splendor.util

Class Constants

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.util.Constants
public final class Constants extends Object
Central registry of application-wide constants used throughout the Splendor game. This utility class provides centralized access to configuration values, game rules, network settings, and logging constants. By consolidating these values in one place, we ensure consistency across the codebase and make configuration changes easier.

Constants are organized into logical groups:

  • Server configuration - network mode settings
  • Game configuration - player counts, winning conditions, token limits
  • Card tiers - tier numbering and display settings
  • Gem configuration - token counts and action requirements
  • Input validation - name length limits and retry counts
  • Network protocol - message delimiters and status codes
  • Logging - format strings and log level identifiers

This class cannot be instantiated; all members are static final constants.

See Also:
  • For runtime-configurable values
  • For configuration property keys
